## Hunt Queries

### Splunk SPL — untested (`query-b26ed9588fec`)

```spl
index=* earliest=-30d (query IN ("c2.example.net", "cdn.example.net", "drop.example.org", "mail.example.net") OR dest_ip IN ("192.0.2.44", "198.51.100.5", "2001:db8::44") OR url IN ("https://login.example.com/c2") OR file_hash IN ("aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"))
| stats count min(_time) AS first_seen max(_time) AS last_seen BY host, src, dest, query, url, file_hash
```

### Microsoft Defender / Sentinel KQL — untested (`query-7285d5981a4a`)

```kql
let lookback = 30d;
let ips = dynamic(["192.0.2.44", "198.51.100.5", "2001:db8::44"]);
let hosts = dynamic(["c2.example.net", "cdn.example.net", "drop.example.org", "login.example.com", "mail.example.net"]);
let hashes = dynamic(["aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"]);
union isfuzzy=true
  (DeviceNetworkEvents | where Timestamp > ago(lookback) | where RemoteIP in (ips) or RemoteUrl has_any (hosts)),
  (DeviceFileEvents | where Timestamp > ago(lookback) | where SHA256 in (hashes))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, SHA256
```

### Elastic EQL (1 of 4) — untested (`query-f5aa817f2a7d`)

```eql
dns where dns.question.name in ("c2.example.net", "cdn.example.net", "drop.example.org", "mail.example.net")
```

### Elastic EQL (2 of 4) — untested (`query-ba8aec698008`)

```eql
network where destination.ip in ("192.0.2.44", "198.51.100.5", "2001:db8::44")
```

### Elastic EQL (3 of 4) — untested (`query-741b92dafa82`)

```eql
any where file.hash.sha256 in ("aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa") or process.hash.sha256 in ("aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa")
```

### Elastic EQL (4 of 4) — untested (`query-f04012913ef3`)

```eql
network where url.full in ("https://login.example.com/c2")
```
